description: Source code for a Zephyr driver implementing non-volatile RAM (bbram) interface for Microchip MCP7940N RTC/Memory chip, including initialization, size querying, validity checks, power standby checks, read/write operations, and device registration.

methods.name: microchip_mcp7940n_bbram_init
methods.description: Initializes the MCP7940N BBRAM device, checks I2C readiness, and reads the RTCWKDAY register.

methods.name: microchip_mcp7940n_bbram_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the SRAM (64 bytes).

methods.name: microchip_mcp7940n_bbram_is_invalid
methods.description: Checks if the RTCWKDAY register indicates a power failure, clears the power fail bit if set, and returns validity status.

methods.name: microchip_mcp7940n_bbram_check_standby_power
methods.description: Checks if standby power (VBAT) is enabled, enables it if not, and returns status.

methods.name: microchip_mcp7940n_bbram_read
methods.description: Reads data from SRAM at specified offset and size.

methods.name: microchip_mcp7940n_bbram_write
methods.description: Writes data to SRAM at specified offset and size.
